Hca Holdings (HCA) Holding Upped by Texan Capital Management; Starbucks Com (SBUX) Share Price Rose While Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Decreased Stake
May 22, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Texan Capital Management increased its stake in Hca Holdings Inc (HCA) by 68.29% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Texan Capital Management bought 9,851 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.36% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 24,276 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.13 million, up from 14,425 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Texan Capital Management who had been investing in Hca Holdings Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $36.31 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.10% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $103.96. About 989,602 shares traded. HCA Healthcare, Inc. (NYSE:HCA) has risen 7.67% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.88% the S&P500.
Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Inc decreased its stake in Starbucks Corp Com (SBUX) by 9.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Inc sold 9,225 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.28% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 85,110 shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.89M, down from 94,335 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Inc who had been investing in Starbucks Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $78.62B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.65% or $0.37 during the last trading session, reaching $56.97. About 2.86 million shares traded. Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) has risen 0.40% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.15% the S&P500.
Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Inc, which manages about $451.99M and $475.89 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Marriott International Inc Com Cl A (NASDAQ:MAR) by 2,450 shares to 51,861 shares, valued at $7.04M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc Com (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 64,080 shares in the quarter, for a total of 132,103 shares, and has risen its stake in Oaktree Capital Group Llc Unit Cl A (NYSE:OAK).
